label: Account
description: One entry of a directory written in a connection: a username, its password (plain, for development) or its scrypt hash (scrypt:<salt>:<hash>, base64url), a display name, the groups it belongs to, and whatever else this directory says about the account. Groups become the roles the sign-in graph writes into the token; attributes become identity.attributes, judged against the shape verify's `type` names.

password.description: plain text; development and tests only

passwordHash.description: scrypt:<salt>:<hash>, both base64url; what a real directory holds

attributes.description: what this directory says about the account beside the fields above; verify answers them as identity.attributes
